initialEmbeddingColdLoad.source: Explicit synthetic /api/embed terminal observation before the first quality run; not a normal Turn
initialEmbeddingColdLoad.note: Ollama accounting, not independent physical/peak measurement. No model pull, GPU options, global settings or explicit unload. Later reproducible 7B probe raw HTTP metadata is preserved separately.

footprintMeasurement: Get-ChildItem of owned private benchmark paths after successful close. Benchmark databaseBytes was measured before final close/checkpoint and is separately retained, not silently substituted. Synthetic vectors measure storage/adapter performance, NOT semantic model quality.
